name: Campingplatz Seespitz - Plansee
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Seespitz is located on the shore of Plansee in the municipality of Breitenwang in Tiroler Außerfern. The surroundings are characterized by dense forests and the mountain backdrop of the Ammergauer Alpen. The site has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as modern sanitary facilities. A restaurant and a kiosk are available on the grounds. The atmosphere is close to nature and quiet, due to the location away from major roads. The lake invites swimming and boating, while the surrounding area offers hiking options. The campsite is particularly suitable for families and outdoor sports enthusiasts. It is open in the season from May to September.
